No live config update occurred in the window: LastModified values are 2026-10-18/19. Recent commits that touched TABLE_NAME or OUTPUT_BUCKET were each reverted, and all commits predate the window. Logs for 20:41:40-20:51:40Z show no error, exception, AccessDenied or timeout lines. About 380 invocations per function ran with max durations well under each timeout (CompressionFunction 829 ms of 60 s, UploaderFunction 418 ms of 30 s), and peak memory stayed far below the configured size (about 100-112 MB used against 256 or 1024 MB).
